πλέονες: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλέων/πλείων, masc. nom. pl. πλέονες (= Attic πλείονες): ’more’
πλεόνεσσι: πλείων — more, more numerous; masc. dat. pl., epic πλεόνεσσι (= Attic πλείοσι)
πλεῖστον: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’most, above all’
πολεμιστής: πολεμιστής — warrior, fighter; masc. nom. sg., in apposition to the subject: ’a warrior’
πολιῆς: πολιός — grey (of the sea); fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
ποσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., ν-movable

πριαμίδην: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
πριαμίδῃ: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam (patronymic), i.e. Hector; masc. dat. sg., in apposition to Ἕκτορι
προμάχων: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. gen. pl.
πρώτοισι: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the foremost’
πυργηδὸν: πυργηδόν — tower-wise, in the manner of a tower; adv. in -ηδόν (πύργος)
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πᾶσα: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., with χθών · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔπαλξις: ’the whole (of it)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with Ἴλιος: ’all (of Ilios)’
πᾶσαι: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl., with πύλαι · also fem. nom. pl. with another fem. noun: ’all’ (πᾶσαι χολάδες ’all the bowels’) · also fem. nom. pl., in apposition to a pronoun: ’all (of them)’ (αἳ … πᾶσαι ’they all’) · also fem. nom. pl. agreeing with feminine town-names: ’all (the towns)’
πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every, whole; fem. acc. sg.
πῆξε: πήγνυμι — fix, plant, fasten; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπηξε): ’fixed, drove in’
σέλας: σέλας — light, gleam, flash; neut. nom./acc. sg.
σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ), after περί: ’about you’ · also gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than you’ (σεῖο … ὀλοώτερος ’deadlier than you’) · also gen. governed by εἵνεκα: ’on your account’ (εἵνεκα σεῖο) · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’away from you’ · also gen. object of μεθήσω: ’let go of you’ (σεῖο μεθήσω ’I will not give you up’)
σκότος: σκότος — darkness; masc. nom. sg., the dark of death
σμερδαλέον: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); fem. acc. pl.
στονόεντα: στονόεις — full of groaning, grievous; neut. acc. pl., epic -όεντα, agreeing with βέλεα
στόμα: στόμα — mouth, face; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’mouth’ (κεφαλὴ στόμα τε ῥῖνές τε ’head and mouth and nostrils’) · also the point of a weapon: ’tip’ (κατὰ στόμα … χαλκῷ ’at the tip, with bronze’)
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’breast’ (Ἥρῃ … στῆθος ’Hera’s breast’)
συλήσων: συλάω — strip, despoil; fut. part. act. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to strip’
σφισιν: σφεῖς — they; epic dat. pl. pron. (= Attic σφίσιν): ’among them, to them’
σόοι: σόος (contracted σῶς) — safe, unharmed; masc. nom. pl., uncontracted
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ (τά οἵ ποτε … πόρε ’which he once gave him’)
τάρφεσιν: τάρφος — thicket, dense cover; neut. dat. pl.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελαμώνιος: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. nom. sg.
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before an enclitic: ’a (man)’ · also masc. acc. sg. with a negative: ’no one’ (οὔ τινά φημι ’I say no one’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μῆτιν: ’some’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶές: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τυτθὸν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’even a little’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a pronoun object: ’small, little’ (τυτθὸν ἐόντα ’being small’)
τόθ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τόθ’ = τότε)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’)
τῇσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ταῖς): ’for them’
φέβοντο: φέβομαι — flee, take flight; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., unaugmented (= ἐφέβοντο)
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι) · also masc. nom. pl., attributive: ’dear’ (φίλοι ἄνδρες ’dear men’)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλων: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. pl. · also attributive with ἑτάρων: ’dear (companions)’ · also substantive, ’loved ones’, in a phrase with πατρίδος αἴης (τῆλε φίλων ’far from loved ones’)
φαεινῷ: φαεινός — shining, bright, radiant; masc./neut. dat. sg.
φευγόντων: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. act. masc. gen. pl.: ’of men who flee’
φονῇσιν: φονή — slaughter, carnage; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
φορέεσκε: φορέω — carry, bear, wear; impf. 3 sg., iterative -εσκ- and unaugmented (= Attic ἐφόρει): ’used to carry, wear’
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; fem. acc. sg.
φρονέων: φρονέω — think, intend, be disposed; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονῶν)
φώς: φώς — man, hero (poetic word); masc. nom. sg.
χέοντο: χέω — pour; mid. pour forth, stream; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐχέοντο): ’were poured out’
χαλκείῳ: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze-tipped; masc./neut. dat. sg.
χραισμεῖν: χραισμέω — ward off, avail, help (+ dat.); aor. inf. act.: ’to help, to avail’
ἀΐξῃ: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. subj. 3 sg. act. (= Attic ᾄξῃ), in a general simile: ’darts forth’
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀγγελίης: ἀγγελίη — message, embassy; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), after ἕνεκα · also fem. gen. sg., of the business, with ἤλυθες: ’on a message’ (τευ ἀγγελίης ’on some news’)
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη) · also fem. voc. sg., in address
ἀκάματον: ἀκάματος — untiring, unwearied; neut. acc. sg., of fire: ’unflagging’
ἀκοντίσσαντος: ἀκοντίζω — hurl a javelin, throw a spear; aor. part. act. masc. gen. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having hurled’
ἀκόντισε: ἀκοντίζω — hurl a javelin, throw a spear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠκόντισε): ’hurled’
ἀκόντων: ἄκων — javelin, dart; masc. gen. pl.
ἀλέξασθαι: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend; aor. inf. mid., + acc. of the thing warded off: ’to defend oneself against’
ἀλκή: ἀλκή — defence, strength to resist, might; fem. nom. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’one another’
ἀμείνων: ἀμείνων — better, stronger; masc. nom. sg., comparative of ἀγαθός · also fem. nom. sg., predicate of φιλοφροσύνη: ’better’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμύντωρ: ἀμύντωρ — defender, helper (from ἀμύνω); masc. nom. sg.
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες) · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’men!’
ἀντίλοχον: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. acc. sg.
ἀντίλοχος: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg. · also + dat., ’to meet, against’ (τῇ δ’ ἀντίος ’to meet her’)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’ · also with σχέο in tmesis: ’back, up’ (ἀνὰ … σχέο = ἀνάσχεο ’hold back’) · also with ἀείραι in tmesis: ’up’ (ἀνὰ … ἀείραι ’raise up’) · also + acc. of place: ’up on’ (ἀνὰ μυρίκην ’up on a tamarisk’)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπέσσυτο: ἀποσεύομαι — rush away, dart off; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic doubled σ (Attic would be ἀπεσεύθη): ’rushed away’
ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀρηρότες: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., intransitive: ’ranged closely, fitted’
ἀρὴν: ἀρή — bane, ruin, harm; fem. acc. sg.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχνύμενοί: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg. · also ἅλς (masc.) — salt; masc. gen. sg., partitive: ’of salt’
ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ
ἄγχι: ἄγχι — near, close; adv.: ’close by’ · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἄλκιμος: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant, brave (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄριστα: ἀγαθός (superl. ἄριστος) — best; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’best’ · also neut. nom. pl., predicate with εἶναι: ’best’ (ἄριστα … εἶναι ’(things) to be best’)
ἅλιον: ἅλιος — vain, to no purpose; masc. acc. sg., predicative with πόνον: ’vain’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’vain’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive: ’vain’ · also neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’vain’ (ἅλιον βέλος ’a vain shaft’) · also neut. nom. sg., attributive: ’vain’ (οὐχ ἅλιον βέλος ’not a vain shaft’) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in vain’ (ἅλιον ὄρουσεν ’darted in vain’)
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐβάλοντο: βάλλω — throw, put; mid. put together, join; aor. 3 pl. mid., augmented, with σύν in tmesis (σὺν … ἐβάλοντο = συνεβάλοντο): ’they joined, set to’
ἐβούλετο: βούλομαι — wish, want, be minded; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’he wished’
ἐγγυάλιξε: ἐγγυαλίζω — put into the hand, hand over; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’has put into (your) hands’
ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἐγχέσπαλος: ἐγχέσπαλος — spear-wielding, spear-brandishing; masc. nom. sg.
ἐδαΐζετο: δαΐζω — tear apart, rend; impf. 3 sg. pass.: ’was torn’
ἐδύναντο: δύναμαι — be able, can; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’they could’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμβάλοι: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, hurl on; aor. opt. 3 sg., in an exception clause after ὅτε μή: ’unless he should throw’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐοικότες: ἔοικα (perf. with pres. force) — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’
ἐοῦσα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐοῦσα (= Attic οὖσα): ’being’
ἐπεσσεύοντο: ἐπισεύομαι — hurry on, rush to; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐπεσεύοντο): ’hastened on’
ἐπόρουσε: ἐπορούω — rush upon, spring upon; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐπώρουσε)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐτέλειον: τελέω — fulfil, accomplish; impf. 3 pl., epic -ει- (= Attic ἐτέλουν)
ἐτέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, contrive, bring about; pass. come to pass, happen; plup. pass. 3 sg.: ’had been made, had come about’
ἐφόβηθεν: φοβέω — frighten; pass. be put to flight, flee; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic -θεν for -θησαν (= Attic ἐφοβήθησαν)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑταίρου: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. gen. sg., of cause with ἀχνύμενος: ’for the comrade’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of a companion’ (παραίφασις ἑταίρου ’a companion’s persuasion’) · also masc. gen. sg. after παρά: ’from a companion’ (παρ’ ἑταίρου) · also masc. gen. sg., object of ἀμέλησεν: ’neglect his companion’
ἓ: ἕ, οὗ, οἷ — him, her, it(self); 3rd-person pron., acc. sg., reflexive: ’himself’
ἔγειρε: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake; 3 sg. aor. or impf. act., unaugmented (= ἤγειρε): ’roused’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’wake!’
ἔγειρεν: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake, stir up; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤγειρεν), with movable ν
ἔθελεν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελεν): ’wished’
ἔθνος: ἔθνος — company, band, throng; neut. acc. sg.
ἔθορε: θρῴσκω — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. (augmented): ’leapt out’
ἔμελλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (root μελλ-, consonant-initial; unaugmented μέλλε(ν)): ’was going to, was destined’
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’steady’
ἔπεσ: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔπεσ’ = ἔπεσε), in tmesis with ἐν: ’fell into’ · also aor. 3 sg., elided, with no preverb: ’fell’ (ἔπεσ’ … χαμαί ’fell to the ground’)
ἔπεφνε: φένω (aor. ἔπεφνον) — slay; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔσσεσθ: εἰμί — be; fut. inf., epic ἔσσεσθαι (= Attic ἔσεσθαι), elided: ’to be’
ἔστε: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 pl. (indic. or imper.): ’you are, be’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλεος: ἕλος — marsh, water-meadow, wet low ground; neut. gen. sg., epic ἕλεος (= Attic ἕλους)
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, bulwark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἕσπετο: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. 3 sg. mid. (ἐ-σπ-ετο, root σεπ-), the augment absorbed: ’followed’
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠλίβατος: ἠλίβατος — towering, steep, sheer (sense of the epic word uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠχῇ: ἠχή — sound, outcry, din; fem. dat. sg.
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἡρακληείῃ: Ἡρακληεῖος — of Heracles, Heraclean; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -εία)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’ · also elided ἦρχον, impf. 3 pl., + gen.: ’were leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀσκάλαφος καὶ Ἰάλμενος) · also elided ἦρχε, impf. 3 sg., + gen.: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀγκαίοιο πάϊς) · also elided ἦρχε, impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’
ἧκεν: ἵημι — send, hurl, let fly; aor. 3 sg. (ἧκα), ν-movable: ’hurled’ · also ’sent forth, let out’, of the voice (ὄπα ἧκεν) · also ’put, set’, with ἐν in tmesis (ἐν … ἧκεν ’set in’)
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. mid. inf., of respect after an adjective: ’to look at’ · also aor. mid. inf., after πάρος: ’before seeing’
ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’)
ὀλοὸν: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὀλέθριον) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆρ: ’deadly’
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
ὀρέξαι: ὀρέγω — stretch out, offer, grant; aor. inf. act.: ’to grant’ (+ acc. κῦδος ’glory’)
ὀρούσας: ὀρούω — rush, spring; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’springing’
ὀρόθυνεν: ὀροθύνω — stir up, rouse; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤροθυνεν): ’roused’
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὀφρύσιν: ὀφρύς — brow, eyebrow; fem. dat. pl., epic -σιν (= Attic -σι), after ὑπό: ’under the brows’
ὁμίλῳ: ὅμιλος — throng, crowd, gathering (esp. of men); masc. dat. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄρνυται: ὄρνυμι — stir up; mid./pass. rise, be roused; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’rises’
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑπέλυσε: ὑπολύω — loosen from beneath, unnerve; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’loosened’
ὑπέρθυμον: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, proud (ὑπέρ + θυμός); masc. acc. sg.
ὑπέρτερον: ὑπέρτερος — higher, greater, superior; comparative adj., neut. acc. sg.
ὑπαὶ: ὑπαί — under; epic lengthened form of ὑπό; prep. + acc. · also adverb, ’underneath, from below’ (ὑπαὶ δὲ ἴδεσκε ’and he would look from under (his brows), downward’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’with’ (ὑπαὶ δείους ’with fear’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’)
ὑσμίνας: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. acc. pl.
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’) · also + gen. of cause: ’from’ (ὑφ’ ὁρμῆς ’from the onrush’)
ὕλης: ὕλη — wood, forest, thicket; fem. gen. sg.
ὕπτιος: ὕπτιος — on one’s back, face up; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’on account of which’ (ᾗ ἔπι ’for which’)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
